displayName: CCD Max Cache Size in MBs
description:
CcdMaxCacheSizeInMBs specifies the maximum local cache size in megabytes, per user, during normal operation. Normal operation assumes that all Cloud Cache providers are available, and that storage performance is adequate to accept I/O at the rate necessary to accommodate profile utilization.

CAUTION: Do not use this setting unless the performance and technical aspects to this setting are fully understood as this setting is a leading cause to poor performance and has limited use cases.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\CcdMaxCacheSizeInMBs
Type:  DWORD
Values: Min (No Limit) = 0, Max = 10000000
